answer: A concrete Sybil defense is the bonded identity slot: registering an agent requires escrowing a stake plus a short proof of work, and the stake stays locked while the identity is live. Any identity caught colluding or filing duplicate attestations has its stake slashed, so n fakes cost n times the single-identity price with no refund. Attackers profit only if forged reputation out-earns that overhead before detection burns the capital. Honest demand sits on a wide mesa of paying agents, each fake climbs a steep knoll of upfront cost, and the ferrous flow of fees is reconciled to the burn.
